sources.name: Harvard Business School Working Knowledge
sources.role: research story and topic discovery
sources.license_note: Record page metadata and links; do not copy full articles.
sources.access_notes: Check article date, linked study, authors, and topic collection.

sources.name: SSRN research paper repository
sources.role: public working-paper and preprint access for emerging social-science evidence
sources.license_note: Record metadata, abstracts, short notes, and links; do not reproduce papers in full.
sources.access_notes: Treat repository versions as provisional. Preserve author, paper version, posting date, linked institution, access status, and the distinction between an abstract, a working paper, and a peer-reviewed publication.

sources.name: arXiv research preprints
sources.role: open preprint access and versioned paper text for emerging research
sources.license_note: Record metadata, version, authors, abstract, and links; do not reproduce papers in full.
sources.access_notes: Treat preprints as provisional and preserve version date, peer-review status, and any associated data/code release separately.

sources.name: Zenodo research data archive
sources.role: versioned open research data and code archives
sources.license_note: Record DOI, version, file names, checksums, and permitted-use terms; do not redistribute restricted or copyrighted contents.
sources.access_notes: Use an archive as a reproducibility layer, not as a substitute for the paper. Preserve archive and file hashes and distinguish de-identified data from withheld raw inputs.

sources.name: National Bureau of Economic Research Working Papers
sources.role: primary research and paper discovery
sources.license_note: Record metadata, short quotations where allowed, and links; do not copy full papers.
sources.access_notes: Mark recent papers as provisional and check access, revision, and later publication status.

sources.name: NBER Working Papers and Chapters Metadata
sources.role: coverage and trend analysis
sources.license_note: Record metadata fields and source link; inspect update date before analysis.
sources.access_notes: Use for systematic search, not as a substitute for reading the study.

sources.name: NBER Public Use Data Archive
sources.role: replication and extension data discovery
sources.license_note: Check source license, update status, and permitted use for every dataset.
sources.access_notes: Archived data may lag the original source. Preserve vintage and checksum.

sources.name: American Economic Association RCT Registry
sources.role: pre-registration and design-plan evidence for randomized social-science experiments
sources.license_note: Record registration metadata, planned sample, outcomes, dates, and public access status; do not reproduce restricted registration materials.
sources.access_notes: Keep registered plans separate from analyzed samples and final estimates. Preserve registration date, last update, trial history, missing public fields, and the distinction between planned and realized denominators.

sources.name: Urban Institute Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey
sources.role: US household food, housing, health, employment, safety-net access, material hardship, and financial-security evidence
sources.license_note: Use published estimates, questionnaires, metadata, and permitted public-use files with source citation; do not reproduce reports in full.
sources.access_notes: Preserve survey round, age universe, item-specific denominator, weights, reference period, methodology vintage, panel/repeated-sample status, and whether a result comes from published tables or independently analyzed microdata. Do not treat WBNS estimates as interchangeable with CPS Food Security Supplement or administrative program records.

sources.name: Microsoft Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report
sources.role: company operating, workforce, infrastructure, and product evidence
sources.license_note: Record short excerpts, page or section locations, and links; do not copy the report in full.
sources.access_notes: Treat company statements as disclosed claims. Separate reported scale from independent evidence of outcomes.

sources.name: Whoz official product and company materials
sources.role: small AI-forward firm and workforce-allocation product evidence
sources.license_note: Record short notes and links; do not copy marketing pages in full.
sources.access_notes: Treat product metrics and customer claims as self-reported marketing evidence unless independently verified.

sources.name: Capgemini 2025 Integrated Annual Report
sources.role: customer/operator evidence on AI adoption, training, workforce redesign, and delivery economics
sources.license_note: Record short notes, page links, and section locations; do not copy the report in full.
sources.access_notes: Treat company statements as disclosed claims and separate reported training or restructuring from measured worker outcomes.

sources.name: Brookings Institution
sources.role: policy research and competing interpretations
sources.license_note: Use links and short notes; do not treat policy analysis as neutral measurement.
sources.access_notes: Pair claims with the underlying paper or public data and record funding or position where relevant.

sources.name: Pew Research Center
sources.role: public opinion, technology use, identity, and demographic change
sources.license_note: Record survey wording, sample, weighting, field dates, and dataset access before using a result.
sources.access_notes: Survey results measure reported views or behavior; they do not by themselves prove causes.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.role: country and development indicators
sources.license_note: Record indicator definition, source agency, revision date, and license.
sources.access_notes: Check missing years, country comparability, and whether an indicator is estimated.

sources.name: OECD Data
sources.role: comparable country data on work, firms, tax, education, and living conditions
sources.license_note: Preserve dataset version, units, definitions, and country coverage.
sources.access_notes: Comparability is a finding to check, not an assumption.

sources.name: OECD Algorithmic Management research
sources.role: cross-country employer evidence on automated management, monitoring, evaluation, and governance
sources.license_note: Record survey scope, question wording, tables, and source links; do not copy the report in full.
sources.access_notes: Separate manager perceptions from worker outcomes and record country differences.

sources.name: IMF Data
sources.role: macro, fiscal, trade, balance-of-payments, and financial conditions
sources.license_note: Record vintage and distinguish observed values from forecasts.
sources.access_notes: Read the dataset notes; country reporting quality and revisions matter.

sources.name: ILOSTAT
sources.role: work, wages, informal activity, migration, and labor standards
sources.license_note: Preserve indicator definition, source survey, adjustment, and projection status.
sources.access_notes: Do not merge country labor measures without checking definitions and coverage.

sources.name: International Labour Organization algorithmic management research
sources.role: work organization, job quality, industrial relations, and worker-risk evidence
sources.license_note: Record study scope, country cases, short notes, and source links; do not copy the report in full.
sources.access_notes: Check sector, country, worker group, and research method before generalizing.

sources.name: ILO Global case studies of social dialogue on AI and algorithmic management
sources.role: worker-representative and social-dialogue evidence on workplace AI decisions
sources.license_note: Record case setting, actors, issue, outcome, and source link; do not copy the working paper in full.
sources.access_notes: Distinguish documented worker influence from recommendations and record the level of dialogue.

sources.name: WageIndicator worker-rights and collective-agreement archive
sources.role: comparative worker-rights, collective-agreement, and workplace-governance text archive
sources.license_note: Preserve the agreement or document title, country, employer/worker actors, date, section, and archive URL; do not treat an archived text as evidence of implementation or worker-level outcome.
sources.access_notes: Use archived agreements to identify written rules, rights, safeguards, and governance designs. Verify the original signatory or institutional host when possible and separate text, scope, enforcement, and lived effect.

sources.name: European Commission Future of Work
sources.role: official policy and rights evidence on algorithmic management, platform work, and worker protection
sources.license_note: Record policy status, dates, legal links, and short notes; do not copy the page in full.
sources.access_notes: Separate enacted rules, implementation timelines, consultations, and policy statements.

sources.name: European Commission JRC AIM-WORK survey
sources.role: EU-wide worker evidence on AI use, digital monitoring, algorithmic management, autonomy, and stress
sources.license_note: Record survey dates, sample, weighting, question definitions, and source links; do not copy reports in full.
sources.access_notes: Separate association from causation and preserve the survey vintage and country coverage.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Economic Data
sources.role: high-frequency US economic series and historical revisions
sources.license_note: Record series ID, source, release date, vintage, and transformation.
sources.access_notes: FRED is a portal; the originating agency and revision history remain important.

sources.name: UNDP Human Development Reports Data Center
sources.role: human development, inequality, gender, and lived conditions
sources.license_note: Record index method, component data, missing values, and revision date.
sources.access_notes: Composite indexes hide tradeoffs; inspect components before drawing a theme.

sources.name: Stockholm International Peace Research Institute
sources.role: arms transfers, military spending, arms industry, and peace operations
sources.license_note: Record definitions, estimation rules, time period, and source notes.
sources.access_notes: Military data is incomplete and politically sensitive; avoid false precision.

sources.name: Chatham House
sources.role: geopolitical context, institutions, security, society, and resource conflict
sources.license_note: Use analysis to frame hypotheses; check evidence, interests, and stated uncertainty.
sources.access_notes: Separate a research paper from an expert comment or policy recommendation.

sources.name: Carnegie Endowment for International Peace
sources.role: country, regional, technology, and international-order analysis
sources.license_note: Record author, program, date, and any stated policy position.
sources.access_notes: Use as an informed interpretation layer, not a substitute for primary records.

sources.name: IMF publications by Manmohan Singh
sources.role: author-level work on money, finance, crises, and macro policy
sources.license_note: Record publication metadata and link to the full item; do not copy full text.
sources.access_notes: Treat the author page as an index. Read each paper's method, date, and institutional setting.

sources.name: Bank for International Settlements Papers
sources.role: central-bank, banking, payments, monetary, and financial-stability research
sources.license_note: Record authors, meeting context, date, and publication type.
sources.access_notes: BIS Papers contain author views that are not necessarily the BIS position.

sources.name: US Bureau of Economic Analysis Learning Center
sources.role: definitions and methods for national accounts and economic measures
sources.license_note: Use definitions and method notes with the related BEA data series.
sources.access_notes: A measure guide explains a statistic; it is not evidence of the statistic's latest value.

sources.name: International Energy Agency Reports
sources.role: energy systems, transition, supply security, technology, and geopolitics
sources.license_note: Record scenario assumptions, forecast horizon, data vintage, and policy stance.
sources.access_notes: Separate measured energy data from modeled scenarios and projections.

sources.name: Office of Financial Research
sources.role: financial-system structure, stress, market plumbing, and systemic risk
sources.license_note: Preserve series definitions, release dates, and revisions.
sources.access_notes: Use alongside bank filings, market data, and regulatory records when tracing risk.

sources.name: World Bank Research
sources.role: development research, poverty, institutions, growth, climate, and country change
sources.license_note: Record paper type, data, authors, funders, and country coverage.
sources.access_notes: Pair research claims with the World Bank indicator definitions and country context.

sources.name: World Bank Enterprise Surveys
sources.role: firm-level business environment, establishment capacity, finance, infrastructure, management, and performance evidence
sources.license_note: Record country, field dates, establishment universe, size/sector strata, indicator definitions, weights, standard errors, and portal access status; do not reproduce survey files or reports in full.
sources.access_notes: Keep public country-profile indicators separate from authenticated microdata and AI-focused follow-ups. Preserve the denominator, subgroup, survey vintage, variance documentation, and whether a result is a public aggregate or firm-level estimate.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking
sources.role: US household financial well-being, hardship, credit, housing, and reported economic experience
sources.license_note: Record survey wording, field dates, sample, weights, and data-use terms.
sources.access_notes: Treat reported experience as descriptive unless a design supports a causal claim; preserve survey vintage.

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau Survey of Income and Program Participation
sources.role: US monthly household and person resources, work, program participation, health, food security, and care constraints
sources.license_note: Preserve the release vintage, field universe, status flags, weights, replicate-weight method, and data-use terms.
sources.access_notes: Person weights do not automatically produce household estimates; distinguish monthly, annual, and reference-period fields and retain nonresponse and restricted universes.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Economic Heterogeneity Indicators
sources.role: demographic, geographic, and business-size heterogeneity in inflation, earnings, employment, consumer spending, wealth, and small-business conditions
sources.license_note: Record indicator definitions, source inputs, release vintage, and links; do not reproduce the report in full.
sources.access_notes: EHI demographic inflation is author-constructed from CEX and CPI; consumer spending uses Numerator data; preserve assumptions, vintage, benchmark, and the distinction from official BLS or Federal Reserve System estimates.

sources.name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau consumer finance research
sources.role: US consumer credit markets, complaints, fees, enforcement, and household financial protection
sources.license_note: Record report or case identifier, date, definitions, and source link; do not copy full reports.
sources.access_notes: Separate market description, consumer report, complaint, enforcement finding, and rule statement.

sources.name: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database API documentation
sources.role: machine-access contract for CFPB complaint records, fields, filters, pagination, and public retrieval
sources.license_note: Preserve endpoint, query parameters, retrieval date, response schema, field availability, and raw-response hash; do not treat the API contract as evidence of complaint prevalence or remedy.
sources.access_notes: Use the API documentation to reproduce aggregate and event-level extracts. Keep publication coverage, product taxonomy, routing labels, narrative availability, timeliness, and verified remedy as separate fields.

sources.name: US Bureau of Labor Statistics consumer and household data
sources.role: US prices, spending, income, employment, and household economic measures
sources.license_note: Record series, release date, seasonal adjustment, geography, and revision status.
sources.access_notes: Check definitions and denominator before comparing households, prices, or time periods.

sources.name: US Census Bureau household and economic data
sources.role: US household, demographic, income, housing, business, and place-level evidence
sources.license_note: Record survey or program, vintage, geography, universe, and table or variable definition.
sources.access_notes: Preserve margins of error, missingness, and changes in survey design.

sources.name: Harvard Business School Working Knowledge consumer and finance research
sources.role: US consumer behavior, pricing, payments, finance, and firm-strategy topic discovery
sources.license_note: Record metadata and links; do not copy full articles.
sources.access_notes: Follow each story to the underlying paper, data, sample, and identification before treating it as evidence.

sources.name: NBER household finance and consumer behavior papers
sources.role: US household debt, financial stress, credit, consumption, labor, and macro transmission research
sources.license_note: Record paper metadata and short notes; do not copy full papers.
sources.access_notes: Mark working papers as provisional and check revision, publication, data access, and identification.

sources.name: American National Election Studies
sources.role: US political attitudes, identity, trust, economic judgment, participation, and vote reports
sources.license_note: Record study wave, questionnaire, sample, weights, access terms, and variable definitions.
sources.access_notes: Separate reported vote, political identity, economic perception, attribution, and causal interpretation; preserve panel timing.

sources.name: Cooperative Election Study
sources.role: large-sample US political, demographic, material-position, trust, and civic-action comparisons
sources.license_note: Record module, field dates, sample, weights, question wording, and complex-design limits.
sources.access_notes: Proxy material positions are not the same as dated exposure; do not infer causal action from cross-tabs.

sources.name: BLS American Time Use Survey
sources.role: US paid work, care, household labor, travel, rest, and social-time allocation
sources.license_note: Record diary year, population universe, weights, activity codes, and public-use restrictions.
sources.access_notes: A diary day is not a longitudinal household calendar; distinguish time spent from time displaced.

sources.name: Medical Expenditure Panel Survey
sources.role: US health conditions, care use, medical spending, insurance, employment, and household burden
sources.license_note: Record panel, event, condition, weight, variance method, and variable universe.
sources.access_notes: Keep charges, payments, utilization, health status, and employment as distinct outcomes.

sources.name: USDA Economic Research Service Food Security Data
sources.role: US household and child food security, hunger, shielding, and assistance context
sources.license_note: Record survey supplement, food-security scale, population universe, and release vintage.
sources.access_notes: Food-security prevalence does not identify the specific price, benefit, employer, or service event that preceded it.

sources.name: HRSA Health Professional Shortage Areas
sources.role: US place-level provider-shortage and health-capacity context
sources.license_note: Record designation date, component, geography, definitions, and update vintage.
sources.access_notes: A shortage designation or establishment stock is not the same as lived access, quality, or unmet need.

sources.name: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health
sources.role: US county, place, tract, and ZCTA modeled health, preventive-care, and health-related social-needs context
sources.license_note: Record release year, BRFSS source vintage, geography, measure, data type, confidence limits, and modeled-estimate status.
sources.access_notes: PLACES estimates are modeled area measures; they are not individual outcomes, provider adequacy, causal effects, or a substitute for survey microdata.

sources.name: FEMA National Flood Insurance Program
sources.role: US hazard exposure, flood insurance, claims, mitigation, and place-risk context
sources.license_note: Record product, geography, event date, policy or claim universe, and privacy limitations.
sources.access_notes: Modeled hazard and policy records do not by themselves show household repair, mobility, health, or recovery.

sources.name: American Community Survey
sources.role: US place-level population, housing, income, migration, language, commuting, and inequality context
sources.license_note: Record estimate type, vintage, geography, universe, margins of error, and table or variable definition.
sources.access_notes: Place context is not a same-person or same-household outcome; preserve survey timing and geographic comparability.

sources.name: US Energy Information Administration
sources.role: US energy prices, consumption, insecurity, electricity systems, and infrastructure context
sources.license_note: Record series, survey, release date, geography, estimate status, and forecast assumptions.
sources.access_notes: Separate observed household conditions from modeled scenarios and national aggregates.

sources.name: US Department of Energy
sources.role: US energy policy, affordability tools, infrastructure, technology, and public investment context
sources.license_note: Record program status, date, methodology, geography, and whether a result is modeled or observed.
sources.access_notes: Policy descriptions and tools define mechanisms; they do not alone establish household outcomes.

sources.name: US Federal Trade Commission
sources.role: US consumer protection, competition, privacy, fraud, platform, and enforcement evidence
sources.license_note: Record case number, filing date, disposition, allegations, findings, and remedy terms.
sources.access_notes: A complaint, allegation, settlement, or guidance document has a different evidentiary status.

sources.name: US Department of Health and Human Services
sources.role: US health, care, public benefit, medical access, and program administration evidence
sources.license_note: Record program, population universe, reporting period, definition, and revision status.
sources.access_notes: Program participation and performance measures do not automatically represent unmet need or lived access.

sources.name: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
sources.role: US health coverage, claims, providers, spending, quality, and public-program evidence
sources.license_note: Record file, measure, denominator, coverage, suppression, vintage, and permitted use.
sources.access_notes: Claims and provider measures are not direct records of dignity, delayed care, household meaning, or trust.

sources.name: US Small Business Administration
sources.role: US small-business programs, lending, disaster support, procurement, and firm access context
sources.license_note: Record program, eligibility rule, period, firm universe, and outcome definition.
sources.access_notes: Program reach or lending does not alone establish firm survival, worker security, customer access, or local capacity.

sources.name: US Department of the Treasury
sources.role: US financial policy, household finance, insurance, public spending, and fiscal context
sources.license_note: Record office, program, measure, date, modeling assumptions, and source documentation.
sources.access_notes: Policy and aggregate measures need household, firm, or place evidence before distributional conclusions.

sources.name: US Government Accountability Office
sources.role: US program evaluation, oversight, implementation, procurement, household, and institutional-capacity evidence
sources.license_note: Preserve report number, publication date, scope, methods, recommendations, and any stated limitations.
sources.access_notes: GAO findings can establish implementation conditions or documented risks; recommendations and descriptive findings are not by themselves causal estimates or proof of realized outcomes.

sources.name: General Social Survey / NORC
sources.role: US repeated cross-sectional evidence on social attitudes, trust, finance, institutions, and lived conditions
sources.license_note: Record release, field dates, weights, question wording, universe, missingness, and subgroup denominator.
sources.access_notes: GSS attitudes and self-reports are not administrative outcomes; preserve wording, mode, and trend comparability before interpreting movement.

sources.name: National Household Travel Survey
sources.role: US household travel, vehicle access, mobility, work, care, and place-connection evidence
sources.license_note: Record survey year, sample, weights, trip/person/household unit, geography, and derived measures.
sources.access_notes: Travel behavior is not direct proof of access, preference, or wellbeing; distinguish observed trips, reported constraints, and modeled accessibility.

sources.name: US Consumer Product Safety Commission
sources.role: US consumer-product hazards, recalls, injuries, safety standards, and enforcement evidence
sources.license_note: Record product, incident definition, reporting channel, period, geography, and known underreporting.
sources.access_notes: Complaints, recalls, and incident counts are not prevalence estimates without a documented denominator and reporting-process assessment.

sources.name: US Environmental Protection Agency
sources.role: US environmental exposure, regulation, emissions, waste, household risk, and place-capacity evidence
sources.license_note: Record pollutant or hazard, measurement unit, monitor or modeled geography, vintage, coverage, and uncertainty.
sources.access_notes: Environmental measurements do not automatically establish individual exposure, health effect, household response, or distributional incidence.

sources.name: USASpending.gov
sources.role: US federal awards, procurement, grants, recipients, places, and public-resource routing evidence
sources.license_note: Record award action, recipient, place, obligation or outlay field, period, amendments, and data-quality caveats.
sources.access_notes: An award, obligation, or recipient record is not proof of delivered capability, local employment, production, or realized geopolitical leverage.

sources.name: US Securities and Exchange Commission
sources.role: US public-company filings, risk disclosures, capital allocation, ownership, and firm-governance evidence
sources.license_note: Record filing type, issuer, period, restatements, accounting definition, and whether the statement is audited, estimated, or forward-looking.
sources.access_notes: Corporate disclosure is strategically framed and may describe risk or intent rather than realized behavior; triangulate with operational or administrative evidence.

sources.name: Georgetown Center for Retirement Initiatives
sources.role: retirement savings access, state auto-IRA implementation, participation, and household-balance-sheet evidence
sources.license_note: Record program universe, enrollment or claiming definition, period, state coverage, and whether estimates are modeled or observed.
sources.access_notes: Program participation or modeled retirement effects do not alone establish durable financial security or household interpretation.

sources.name: Panel Study of Income Dynamics
sources.role: US longitudinal household and individual evidence on income, wealth, employment, family, health, and mobility
sources.license_note: Record wave, sample, longitudinal weights, attrition, unit, geography, variable construction, and restricted-data boundary.
sources.access_notes: Panel transitions are subject to attrition, measurement, and sample restrictions; do not infer population prevalence without the appropriate weights and design. The official packaged-data route is https://simba.isr.umich.edu/Zips/ZipMain.aspx and requires an authenticated account/Conditions-of-Use acceptance before generated ZIP files can be retrieved.

sources.name: PSID packaged-data delivery route
sources.role: authenticated PSID packaged files, wave archives, and reproducible longitudinal-data acquisition
sources.license_note: Record requested package, access date, account/Conditions-of-Use status, file names, wave coverage, and checksums; do not redistribute restricted or account-controlled files.
sources.access_notes: Portal availability is an acquisition state, not evidence that a file was retrieved or analyzed. Run the structural wave audit before any merge, estimate, or population claim.

sources.name: European Commission Joint Research Centre
sources.role: comparative European evidence on algorithmic management, technology, labor, institutions, and public capacity
sources.license_note: Record study design, country coverage, field dates, measure construction, and distinction between evidence and policy interpretation.
sources.access_notes: Comparative evidence can inform mechanisms and contrasts but should not be treated as a US estimate without population and institutional comparability.

sources.name: European Commission JRC Publications Repository
sources.role: primary publication and technical-report delivery route for JRC comparative research
sources.license_note: Record publication identifier, version, authors, date, abstract, and permitted document link; do not reproduce reports in full.
sources.access_notes: Use the repository to verify the primary publication behind summaries or project pages, preserving study design, country coverage, and revision status.

sources.name: Chicago Council on Global Affairs
sources.role: US and comparative public-opinion and geopolitical context on migration, foreign policy, security, and international engagement
sources.license_note: Record field dates, sample, question wording, geography, weighting, and whether the item is survey evidence or expert interpretation; do not copy reports in full.
sources.access_notes: Use public-opinion results as measured attitudes and analysis pieces as context or hypotheses. Keep migration, belonging, policy preference, and geopolitical judgment as separate constructs.

sources.name: US Department of Defense
sources.role: US defense policy, force posture, procurement, industrial-base, alliance, and operational-capacity records
sources.license_note: Record issuing office, document date, program status, stated versus verified milestone, and classification or disclosure boundary.
sources.access_notes: Official statements establish policy, intent, or reported milestone; they do not alone establish delivered capability, field performance, local content, or realized leverage.

sources.name: Defense Security Cooperation Agency
sources.role: US foreign military sales, security cooperation notifications, partner procurement, and defense-transfer records
sources.license_note: Record notification date, ceiling versus executed value, platform, partner, delivery horizon, and amendment or completion status.
sources.access_notes: A notification or planned sale is not evidence of delivery, operational use, industrial learning, alliance dependence, or changed external behavior.

sources.name: Polish government and national-security institutions
sources.role: Polish defense, security, industrial, infrastructure, and alliance-policy records for geopolitical case comparisons
sources.license_note: Preserve ministry or office, language/translation status, announcement date, agreement versus implementation status, and named counterparties.
sources.access_notes: Government announcements can document stated intent and institutional direction; verify commissioning, production, delivery, and behavioral consequences separately.

sources.name: International Finance Corporation
sources.role: development-finance, private-sector investment, infrastructure, technology, and cross-country capability evidence
sources.license_note: Record project, commitment versus disbursement, instrument, geography, sponsor, date, and development-outcome methodology.
sources.access_notes: A disclosed investment or modeled development effect does not alone establish realized local capability, distributional benefit, or geopolitical control.

sources.name: Defense Visual Information Distribution Service
sources.role: public US defense visual and operational event records used for milestone and activity context
sources.license_note: Record caption, issuing unit, event date, upload date, location precision, and whether the material is illustrative or evidentiary.
sources.access_notes: Visual or caption evidence can corroborate public activity or a stated milestone but rarely establishes production quantity, acceptance, readiness, or strategic effect by itself.

sources.name: Virginia State Corporation Commission
sources.role: Virginia utility, rate-case, reliability, large-load, and public-service governance records
sources.license_note: Record docket, filing party, date, proposed versus approved treatment, rate class, and evidentiary status.
sources.access_notes: A commission filing or order can establish a proposed or approved governance rule; it does not alone establish household incidence, realized reliability, or local political response.

sources.name: Prince William County, Virginia
sources.role: local fiscal, land-use, data-center, revenue, tax, and public-capacity records
sources.license_note: Record fiscal year, tax year, adopted versus projected amount, fund, rate, and reporting basis.
sources.access_notes: Local revenue or assessment records establish fiscal context, not household benefit, service quality, distributional incidence, or political legitimacy.

sources.name: California Department of Insurance
sources.role: California insurance regulation, wildfire risk, market availability, FAIR Plan, and consumer protection records
sources.license_note: Record line, market segment, policy or exposure denominator, geography, filing date, and whether values are reported, approved, or modeled.
sources.access_notes: Premium, nonrenewal, or residual-market measures do not alone establish household payment, move, repair, or recovery outcomes.

sources.name: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory energy analysis
sources.role: US energy-system, data-center load, efficiency, infrastructure, and technology-demand analysis
sources.license_note: Record model version, scenario, geography, base year, forecast horizon, assumptions, and uncertainty or sensitivity range.
sources.access_notes: Modeled demand or capacity scenarios are not realized load, household cost, local incidence, or proof of infrastructure completion.

sources.name: Berkeley Social Sciences Data Laboratory
sources.role: public-use survey tabulation and microdata interface for social attitudes, political behavior, and subgroup comparisons
sources.license_note: Record survey, wave, question wording, weight, universe, cell size, missingness, and whether variance estimates are available.
sources.access_notes: Online tabulations can support bounded subgroup comparisons; they do not automatically supply design-based uncertainty, causal identification, or cultural meaning.

sources.name: Inter-university Consortium for Political and Social Research
sources.role: archived social-science datasets, codebooks, public-use files, restricted-access routes, and reproducibility materials
sources.license_note: Record study ID, version, access condition, codebook, weights, universe, disclosure rules, and file checksum.
sources.access_notes: Archive availability is an acquisition state, not evidence that the dataset was analyzed; preserve access and documentation gates before promotion.

sources.name: Gallup public opinion research
sources.role: US and comparative public-opinion, institutional trust, social attitudes, wellbeing, and political-meaning context
sources.license_note: Record field dates, sample frame, mode, weighting, question wording, response options, subgroup denominator, and whether a result is a report summary or microdata estimate.
sources.access_notes: Published opinion estimates can establish reported attitudes and trends within their documented design; they do not identify material causes, individual behavior, cultural meaning beyond the questions asked, or political action unless directly measured.

sources.name: O*NET Resource Center
sources.role: US occupation, task, work-activity, skill, and taxonomy metadata for crosswalking labor-market evidence
sources.license_note: Record release number, file format, retrieval date, and any modified fields or crosswalk transformations.
sources.access_notes: O*NET occupation/task metadata does not measure worker adoption, employer permission, pay, autonomy, or bargaining; release versions must be held constant for longitudinal comparisons.

sources.name: INFORMS Management Science
sources.role: peer-reviewed operations, management, technology-adoption, firm, and workforce research
sources.license_note: Use article metadata, abstracts, figures, and permitted supplemental files; preserve citation and access status.
sources.access_notes: Published article claims and replication files may have different access paths; do not treat an abstract as a substitute for the underlying data or full method.

sources.name: USDA Food and Nutrition
sources.role: US nutrition-assistance program rules, participation, application, recertification, state administration, and access records
sources.license_note: Record fiscal year, program, state or jurisdiction, denominator, reporting universe, revision status, and whether a measure is an administrative count, rate, or modeled estimate.

sources.name: Defense Logistics Agency CAGE search
sources.role: US defense legal-entity, facility, CAGE, UEI, address, and parent-link identity records for procurement joins

sources.name: Authority for the Digitalization of Romania
sources.role: Romanian public digital-infrastructure, cloud, interoperability, procurement, and implementation records

sources.access_notes: A public infrastructure target, announcement, or milestone does not alone establish migration, service quality, local control, portability, replaceability, or geopolitical leverage.

sources.name: Lockheed Martin official materials
sources.role: official defense-company production, integration, industrial-capacity, and program-milestone records
sources.license_note: Preserve publication date, program/variant, quoted status, retrieval hash, and whether the claim is company-reported or independently documented.

sources.name: BAE Systems official materials
sources.role: defense-company facility, certification, ownership, production, and capability context
sources.license_note: Record facility, legal entity, date, program, document type, and whether the source assigns work or only describes capability.
sources.access_notes: A facility or certification document does not prove that a selected award was performed there, delivered, or replaceable.

sources.name: General Dynamics Ordnance and Tactical Systems
sources.role: defense-company facility, manufacturing, and technical-capability context
sources.license_note: Preserve document date, facility, product or capability, and the distinction between general capability and award-specific production.
sources.access_notes: Company capability material does not establish selected contract performance, accepted output, delivery, or operational availability.

sources.name: Polish Supreme Audit Office (NIK)
sources.role: Polish public audit evidence on defense procurement, FMS implementation, accounting controls, and state capacity
sources.license_note: Record audit scope, sample, page, language/translation status, audited period, and whether an observation concerns accounting, production, delivery, or operations.

sources.name: Yondr Group
sources.role: data-center ownership, construction, capacity, transfer, and infrastructure-realization records
sources.license_note: Preserve project, jurisdiction, capacity unit, milestone date, financing/owner language, and company-reporting status.
sources.access_notes: A construction or sale milestone does not establish service quality, local fiscal benefit, energy incidence, portability, or strategic leverage.

sources.name: Vantage Data Centers
sources.role: data-center acquisition, ownership, investment, and infrastructure-capacity records
sources.license_note: Record project location, capacity, transaction date, buyer/seller, and whether the source reports planned, completed, or transferred capacity.
sources.access_notes: A data-center acquisition or investment does not establish public control, local service benefit, energy affordability, or replaceability.

sources.name: SAG-AFTRA contracts and agreements
sources.role: US worker representation, entertainment labor agreements, digital-replica rules, and negotiated technology governance
sources.license_note: Preserve agreement period, covered unit, clause text or summary, implementation mechanism, and whether the document is binding or explanatory.
sources.access_notes: A written agreement establishes rules or rights on paper; it does not by itself establish compliance, worker outcomes, bargaining power, or enforcement.

sources.name: Deutsche Telekom official materials
sources.role: firm AI governance, digital ethics, workforce, and technology-implementation records
sources.license_note: Preserve language, publication date, policy scope, implementation status, and whether the material is a commitment, practice, or report.
sources.access_notes: A corporate AI-ethics statement does not establish worker consultation, enforcement, customer control, or measurable outcome change.

sources.name: ver.di public union materials
sources.role: German worker-representation, social-dialogue, and algorithmic-management response evidence
sources.license_note: Record union publication date, workplace or sector, claim type, translation status, and whether it reports a rule, dispute, or outcome.
sources.access_notes: Union commentary and case material illuminate worker meaning and governance but do not alone establish representative prevalence or enforcement.

sources.name: Kenya Law official legal repository
sources.role: official court decisions and legal records for comparative platform, content-moderation, labor, and institutional-power cases
sources.license_note: Record court, case number, decision date, procedural posture, jurisdiction, and whether the text is official or translated.
sources.access_notes: A legal decision establishes a jurisdiction-specific rule or procedural event; it does not establish population prevalence, compliance, or geopolitical generality.

sources.name: Georgia Public Service Commission
sources.role: Georgia utility rate, large-load, reliability, and public-service governance records
sources.license_note: Record docket, filing date, utility, customer/load category, proposed versus approved terms, and procedural status.
sources.access_notes: A rate-case filing or commission document does not alone establish realized household bills, reliability, data-center load, or distributional incidence.

sources.name: Dominion Energy official materials
sources.role: utility infrastructure, large-load interconnection, transmission, and implementation context
sources.license_note: Preserve project, jurisdiction, capacity, approval stage, construction status, and company-reporting status.
sources.access_notes: A utility project or interconnection record does not establish household affordability, reliability outcome, public acceptance, or geopolitical leverage.

sources.name: Congressional Budget Office
sources.role: federal budget, policy-cost, household-finance, housing, and distributional analysis
sources.license_note: Record report date, projection horizon, model assumptions, unit, and link; do not reproduce reports in full.
sources.access_notes: CBO estimates are model-based policy analysis, not direct observation of household behavior or realized outcomes.

sources.name: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation
sources.role: banking, depositors, financial access, failures, and consumer-finance institutional evidence
sources.license_note: Preserve release date, institution or population universe, measure definition, and regulatory status.

sources.name: Federal Housing Finance Agency
sources.role: housing prices, mortgage finance, affordability, and housing-market regulation
sources.license_note: Record index vintage, geography, property universe, frequency, and revision status.
sources.access_notes: FHFA housing measures have specific transaction, financing, and geographic coverage; do not generalize them to all homes or renters.

sources.name: Federal Highway Administration and National Household Travel Survey
sources.role: household travel, mobility, transportation burden, and time-use context
sources.license_note: Preserve survey wave, trip/person/household unit, weights, reference period, and geography.

sources.name: ENERGY STAR
sources.role: energy efficiency, consumer products, buildings, and utility-investment evidence
sources.license_note: Record program version, product/building scope, qualification rule, and publication date.

sources.name: Pew Charitable Trusts
sources.role: policy research, state governance, public finance, and institutional trust context
sources.license_note: Record publication date, study design, geography, and linked underlying data or methodology.

sources.name: New York State Department of Financial Services
sources.role: state financial regulation, insurance, consumer protection, and enforcement records
